sourceTitle: Salmon and Brie Wrapped In Bacon
sourceText:
Salmon and Brie Wrapped In Bacon
By: Zomppa
Published: Wednesday, March 30, 2011 - 8:12am

Ingredients




1 piece salmon fillet
Brie
4 slices bacon

Preparation

1 Cut salmon into 4 1-inch pieces 2 Make small slits in the salmon and add salt, pepper, and brie into slits 3 Wrap bacon around pieces 4 Heat skillet and oil 5 Place pieces in skillet and cook until fish is done

About
